title: After 'The Wood Question' shows 'Quest done' (settled at the Woodward's Cot: 'keep the rides exactly as they are,' with Hollis marking it on his map that same afternoon), the verderer Colm still offers 'argue him out of the warrant' / 'make the cost of refusal plain,' both costing Crown reputation, with no acknowledgment the matter is settled. A retry failed and still cost Crown standing on what the status screen already listed as a closed quest.
where: Kingswood / The Verderer's Post (talk to Colm)
